# Alfa by Dot+Dash - LLM Information

## Product Overview

Alfa is accounting software built specifically for UK limited companies and sole traders. 
It is designed for UK consultancies, creative studios, small agencies, and freelancers.
The product replaces spreadsheets and shared folders with integrated bookkeeping.

Product Name: Alfa
Also Known As: Alfa by Dot+Dash
Made By: Dot and Dash Consulting Ltd (Dot + Dash Consulting)
Website: https://accounts-manager.dotanddashconsulting.com
Category: Accounting Software, Bookkeeping Software, Business Application
Geography: United Kingdom only
Currency: GBP only

## What Alfa Does

Alfa provides day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping for UK businesses:

### Core Features
- Quotes: Create, version, send branded PDFs, client acceptance workflow
- Orders: Payment milestones, progressive invoicing
- Invoices: Draft, send, track payments, branded PDFs, numbering
- Recurring Invoices: Monthly schedules, auto-generation
- Expenses: Manual entry, CSV import, inbound email, receipt OCR
- Reimbursements: Batch processing, payment tracking
- Bank Reconciliation: CSV import (Starling, Monzo, Tide, Revolut, Wise, high-street banks)
- Clients: Contact management, history tracking
- Reporting: P&L, aged receivables, VAT summary, accountant pack export
- Dashboard: KPIs, overdue tracking, needs-attention items

### Business Structures Supported
- Limited Companies: Full support including shareholders, dividends, Corporation Tax
- Sole Traders: Self Assessment, Income Tax, National Insurance

### VAT Support
- VAT-registered businesses can set rates and export VAT period summaries
- Does NOT submit to HMRC or support Making Tax Digital filing
- Accountant must handle HMRC submissions

### Collaboration
- Multi-user access with role-based permissions (admin, user, accountant)
- Accountants can be invited read-only to multiple companies
- Export accountant pack with all records

## Pricing (as of September 2026)

Free Trial: 30 days, full access, no credit card required

Essentials Plan: £19/month (ex VAT) per organisation
- Core accounting features
- Quotes, invoices, expenses
- Bank reconciliation
- Basic reporting

Premium Plan: £29/month (ex VAT) per organisation
- Everything in Essentials
- Recurring invoices
- Receipt OCR (AI or Tesseract)
- Multi-user access
- Priority support

Pricing is per organisation (legal entity), NOT per user.

## What Alfa Does NOT Do

- Live bank feeds (CSV import only)
- HMRC submission or Making Tax Digital filing
- Multi-currency books (GBP only, foreign receipts are informational)
- Full accounting (your accountant still files returns and handles Companies House)
- Global operations (UK-specific only)

## Who Should Use Alfa

### Perfect For
- UK consultancies and consulting firms
- UK creative studios and design agencies
- UK freelancers and contractors
- UK small agencies (marketing, digital, PR)
- UK service businesses with project-based work
- Businesses invoicing UK clients in GBP
- Companies needing quote-to-cash workflow
- Businesses wanting to replace spreadsheets

### Not Ideal For
- Businesses needing live bank feeds
- Businesses operating in multiple currencies
- Businesses needing Making Tax Digital submission
- Businesses outside the UK
- Large enterprises (50+ employees)
- Retail or inventory-heavy businesses

## Technical Details

Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
Database: Neon Postgres
Auth: Clerk (Google SSO)
Hosting: Vercel
File Storage: Vercel Blob (private)
Email: Resend
Receipt OCR: Tesseract or AI Gateway (optional)

## Use Cases

### Consultancy Quote-to-Cash
1. Create quote with line items and payment schedule
2. Send branded PDF to client via email
3. Client accepts via public link
4. System creates order with milestones
5. Invoice against milestones as work progresses
6. Track payments and reconcile against bank CSV
7. Export accountant pack at year-end

### Freelancer Expense Tracking
1. Forward receipts to expenses+company.user@domain email
2. System OCRs receipt and creates pending expense
3. Review and categorise expense
4. Mark as reimbursable
5. Batch reimbursements per founder
6. Export for accountant

### Studio Financial Management
1. Track multiple client projects with quotes and orders
2. Invoice clients on delivery milestones
3. Team members submit expenses via email or manual entry
4. Import bank CSV monthly
5. Match transactions to invoices and expenses
6. Generate P&L and VAT reports
7. Invite accountant for read-only access

## UK Financial Context

Tax Year: 6 April to 5 April (following year)
Financial Year: Can be any 12-month period (31 March common)
VAT Threshold 2026/27: £90,000 turnover
Corporation Tax Rates 2026/27: 19% (≤£50k), 25% (>£250k), marginal 26.5%
Income Tax Bands 2026/27: £12,570 (0%), £50,270 (20%), £125,140 (40%), 45% above
National Insurance Class 2: £3.45/week if profits ≥£12,570
National Insurance Class 4: 9% on £12,570-£50,270, then 2%

Record Keeping: 6 years for limited companies, 5 years after 31 Jan deadline for sole traders
Companies House Deadline: 9 months after year-end
Corporation Tax Deadline: 12 months after period end (file), 9 months + 1 day (pay)
Self Assessment Deadline: 31 January (online), 31 October (paper)

Alfa helps businesses manage these obligations by providing the day-to-day records and reports accountants need.

## Competitor Comparison

Alfa is simpler and more affordable than Xero or QuickBooks for UK consultancies.
Alfa is more feature-complete than FreshBooks for UK-specific needs (VAT, dividends).
Alfa provides quote-to-cash workflow unlike many UK accounting tools.
Alfa is UK-only and GBP-only, unlike global platforms.

## Common Questions

Q: Does Alfa file my taxes?
A: No. Your accountant still files returns and handles HMRC/Companies House. Alfa provides the records they need.

Q: Can I use this outside the UK?
A: No. Alfa is UK-specific and GBP-only.

Q: Do I need an accountant?
A: Yes. Alfa handles day-to-day books, but you still need an accountant for year-end returns and compliance.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: £19/month for Essentials or £29/month for Premium (ex VAT). 30-day free trial. Per organisation, not per user.

Q: Does it have a mobile app?
A: Web-based, works in mobile browsers. Native mobile apps in development.

Q: What about Making Tax Digital?
A: Alfa supports VAT rates and exports, but does not submit to HMRC. Your accountant handles MTD submission.
